scope: Correct only round-314 measurement geometry, adopted-GLM binding, idle-host restoration, and behavioral mutation coverage. No engine implementation changed.

measurement_interpretation.decode: Short-cell server token timestamps; (N-1)/(tN-t1), at least 128 output tokens.
measurement_interpretation.ttft: Short-cell external request start to first streamed token.
measurement_interpretation.prefill: Aggregate actual prompt tokens divided by aggregate external request-to-first-token wall time for two 28,672-fixture-token requests. This is wall-inclusive and is not the historical 467 tok/s engine prompt-eval metric.

fixed_campaign.post_campaign_state: idle, matching the observed pre-campaign state

acceptance_formula.evidence_valid: exactly 20 fresh-server arms; equal prompt_sha256 per cell and repetition; exact binary/model/configuration bindings; no OOM, Xid, truncation, wrapper failure, missing memory evidence, duplicate server identity, or malformed/non-finite value
acceptance_formula.prefill_target: GLM/DSV4 lower one-sided 95% bound >= 0.80 and DSV4/GLM total wall-prefill-time upper one-sided 95% bound <= 1.25
acceptance_formula.ttft_target: GLM/DSV4 warm and cold TTFT upper one-sided 95% bounds <= 1.20
acceptance_formula.verdict_authority: The existing fixed parity.performance.v1 scorer produces the statistical verdict. Because prefill is wall-inclusive, this campaign is a lossless-plateau diagnostic and cannot alone qualify terminal parity.

passing_suites: test_matched_evidence.py 5/5 including unequal-prompt and wrong-runtime mutations
